$comment: Licenses that pass scripts/check-licenses.mjs automatically (decision DEC-6, jotdown D-6).
Same allow-list as sketch2cad-api/licenses-allowed.txt; one normalized identifier per entry.
LGPL is accepted by DEC-6 only through one documented exception per dependency in
license-exceptions.json, so it is deliberately NOT listed here.
GPL and AGPL are forbidden and cannot be allowed by any exception (spec section 2.2).
Extended by owner decision on 2026-10-25: any permissive or weak file-level license is acceptable (ISC, BlueOak, MIT-0, 0BSD, Zlib, CC0, CC-BY, MPL-2.0). GPL/AGPL stays forbidden.
